designationHistory.name: Quillayute Needles Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt set aside the small islands off the Washington coast between latitudes 47°38′ and 48°02′ N, including the Quillayute Needles, as the Quillayute Needles Reservation by Executive Order 705 on October 23, 1907.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (2007 CCP: the three Washington island reservations were set aside by T.R. on October 23, 1907, by EOs 703, 704 and 705) and Pass B (order text on Wikisource: EO 705 creates the "Quillayute Needles Reservation," dated October 23, 1907) agree. The CCP is inconsistent about which of the three order numbers belongs to which refuge; the order text settles it as 705. Renamed Quillayute Needles National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, dated July 25, 1940 (one CCP passage says July 30).
